folio_labels = {}
for p in folio_full:
    folio_labels[p["answer"]] = folio_labels.get(p["answer"], 0) + 1
print("FOLIO full: {} problems".format(len(folio_full)))
print("  Label distribution: {}".format(folio_labels))
